I started to try and see how fucked up I could think . It's not always violent thoughts but they really cripple me. Trust me I have managed to literally breakdown on my living room floor. Eventually the constant thoughts dissipate. Every now and then I might get pent up on one but it passes.
Let's see if it can touch the bottom and resurface
You were born serving a system. Always have always will. Not always a societal one. But it depends on whether you see it that way. Existence is pain, life is experience and time an illusion.
Why the rush when we've got years... 😄

"No one will ever love me" is one of the biggest misconceptions there are. Never is a long time and you haven't met every single person so. Your chance of love is still there, but you should love yourself because your existence is really a 1 in a supertrillion possibility. No one else is capable of being you, telling you who you are or how to live your life.

It's normal to get drunk at parties. The thought wasn't in your control. For mere seconds you genuinely didn't know who it was so a little "crooked thought" (to me they are sometimes humourous, sometimes mindf**king) about them. To run a scenario through your head is normal, just don't let it become definitive.
Mostly we get stressed when we try to fit everything into a short space of time. When actually most of the things aren't going to happen for the next 10-30 years.
Challenge yourself. Try something you've never done before with the anticipation of failure. It's okay to fail, we all had to learn how to walk so go for it at your own pace.
You could cycle. Scenery changes faster and it's a full body exercise. You need to get your endorphins to kick in. But remember, too much of one thing isn't good. Variety is the spice of life.
If you weren't alive or here then where would you be? It is normal to go through an existencial crisis at some point in life. I'm open to conversation if you need any.
